endpoint.title: Create a QR code
endpoint.description: Creates a new QR code. For Dynamic QRs the short redirect code is generated automatically. For password-protected QRs supply the raw password — it will be hashed server-side.
notes: Plan limits apply: Free accounts can create up to 5 QR codes. Pro allows unlimited.
Password QRs require the password field and are always dynamic.

bodyParams.name: name
bodyParams.description: Display name for this QR code. Max 200 chars.

bodyParams.name: target_url
bodyParams.description: The destination URL. Required for url, smart_routing, and password types. Must begin with https:// or http://.

bodyParams.name: is_dynamic
bodyParams.description: When true, the QR encodes a short redirect that can be updated without reprinting. Default: true.

bodyParams.name: password
bodyParams.description: Required when type is password. Raw string — hashed server-side. Never stored in plaintext.

bodyParams.name: design
bodyParams.description: Design configuration. See Design object below.

bodyParams.name: design.dot_color
bodyParams.description: Hex color for QR dots. Default: #000000.

bodyParams.name: design.background_color
bodyParams.description: Hex color for QR background. Default: #ffffff.

bodyParams.name: design.error_correction
bodyParams.description: Error correction level. Higher levels allow larger logos but reduce data density.

responseSchema.name: short_code
responseSchema.description: 8-character URL-safe redirect code. Null for static QRs.

responseSchema.name: redirect_url
responseSchema.description: Full scannable URL encoded in the QR (e.g. https://r.qrise.io/abc12345). Null for static QRs.

responseSchema.name: is_dynamic
responseSchema.description: Whether this QR uses a redirect.

responseSchema.name: is_active
responseSchema.description: Whether this QR is currently scannable.

examples.python:
import requests
response = requests.post('https://api.qrise.io/qr',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    json={'name': 'Summer sale campaign', 'type': 'url', 'target_url': 'https://yourstore.com/summer-sale', 'is_dynamic': True})
qr = response.json()
print(qr['redirect_url'])
examples.curl: curl -X POST https://api.qrise.io/qr -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "Summer sale campaign", "type": "url", "target_url": "https://yourstore.com/summer-sale", "is_dynamic": true}'
